battleAbilities.name: Bluff
battleAbilities.description: Bluff - (Passive) If this character has less current HP than the opponent, it gains +2 EV.

cards.flavorText: “In this world, people don't lose to fate or luck; they lose to their own arrogance. And I am a master at making opponents believe they are invincible.”

cards.name: SORA
cards.subtitle: Humanity's Representative

tournamentAbilities.name: Negotiation
tournamentAbilities.description: Negotiation - Generate 1 Energy. Gamble: Choose an opponent. They choose odd or even, then roll a d6. (Win) You draw 1 card. (Lose) That opponent draws 1 card.

battleAbilities.name: Psychological Warfare
battleAbilities.description: Psychological Warfare - (Active) Gamble (Call Heads or Tails): (Win) The opponent gets -500 ATK this turn. (Lose) This character gets -200 ATK this turn.

cards.flavorText: “We are Imanity, the weakest of the sixteen races! Born with nothing, we hold the limitless potential to become anything!”

cards.name: SORA
cards.subtitle: King of Imanity

tournamentAbilities.name: All or Nothing
tournamentAbilities.description: All or Nothing - Generate 1 Energy. Gamble (Rock-Paper-Scissors with opponent): (Win) Generate 3 additional Energy. (Lose or Tie) Lose all Energy generated this round.

battleAbilities.name: Rule Bending
battleAbilities.description: Rule Bending - (Passive) While this character is active, you may reroll one Gamble attempt per turn (you must accept the second result).

cards.flavorText: “Never look down on humanity! A true king doesn't rule by force; he shows his people how to triumph using their minds.”

cards.name: SORA
cards.subtitle: The Grandmaster

tournamentAbilities.name: Checkmate Setup
tournamentAbilities.description: Checkmate Setup - Generate 2 Energy. Gamble (Guess High/Low on d20): (Win) Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may put 1 of them into your hand. (Lose) Draw 3 fewer cards during your next Draw Phase.

battleAbilities.name: Solution Calculation
battleAbilities.description: Solution Calculation - (Active) Gamble (Name a number 1-20, roll d20): (Win - Result is within 3 numbers of declaration) This attack deals double damage. (Lose) This attack deals half damage.

cards.flavorText: “Checkmate wasn't decided on this turn. The very second you agreed to sit across from me, the game was already over.”

cards.subtitle: God of Games

tournamentAbilities.name: Aschente
tournamentAbilities.description: Aschente - Generate 3 Energy. Cheat: Choose any non-Boss card in the Market. Its cost becomes 0 for you this turn (it still counts as buying a high-cost card if applicable). Only once per game.

battleAbilities.name: All According to Plan
battleAbilities.description: All According to Plan - (Enter) Reveal and maintain your opponent's entire Lineup revealed, then swap this card with a random card on your Lineup (roll 1dX, where X is the number of alive characters on your Lineup). (Reserve) At the start of any turn (yours or the opponent's), you may rearrange the order of the characters in your Reserve.

cards.flavorText: “『 』 never loses. Across every world and every dimension, there is no game that can withstand our united intellect.”

cards.name: SHIRO
cards.subtitle: Quiet Genius

tournamentAbilities.name: Analysis
tournamentAbilities.description: Analysis - Generate 0 Energy. Look at the top card of the Market deck.

battleAbilities.name: Calculation
battleAbilities.description: Calculation - (Passive) This character never misses attacks (ignores Evasion), but cannot score Critical Hits.

cards.flavorText: “Chess is merely a finite system of 10 to the 120th power states. To humanity, that feels like infinity; to me, it's just a simple equation.”

cards.name: SHIRO
cards.subtitle: Logical Gamer

tournamentAbilities.name: Predictive Algorithm
tournamentAbilities.description: Predictive Algorithm - Generate 1 Energy. Gamble (Roll d6): (Win - Even) Look at the top 3 cards of the Market Deck, arrange them in any order. (Lose - Odd) Shuffle the Market Deck.

battleAbilities.name: Dodge Calculation
battleAbilities.description: Dodge Calculation - (Active) Gamble (Roll d6): (Win - Even) Gain +4 EV for the next attack. (Lose - Odd) Lose -2 EV for the next attack.

cards.flavorText: “Wind speed zero. Ricochet angle calculated at 37.4 degrees. Target eliminated in 0.8 seconds.”

cards.name: SHIRO
cards.subtitle: Queen of Imanity

tournamentAbilities.name: Perfect Solution
tournamentAbilities.description: Perfect Solution - Generate 1 Energy. Gamble (Guess High/Low on d20): (Win) Draw 2 cards. (Lose) Skip your next Buy Phase turn.

battleAbilities.name: FPS Mode
battleAbilities.description: FPS Mode - (Passive) This character deals +500 damage if the opponent has higher current HP than you.

cards.flavorText: “Sora is my voice and heart, but I am the unbreakable foundation of our throne. Challenge our kingdom, and the math will be merciless.”

cards.name: SHIRO
cards.subtitle: Omega Computing

tournamentAbilities.name: Complete Knowledge
tournamentAbilities.description: Complete Knowledge - Permanent: Generate 1 Energy. At the start of each round, you may reveal an opponent's hand until the end of the round.

battleAbilities.name: Determinism
battleAbilities.description: Determinism - (Passive) Once per battle, you may change the result of any one die roll (yours or your opponent's) to a result of your choice.

cards.flavorText: “Every single outcome simulated across ten million possibilities. Probability of our defeat: 0.000000%.”

cards.name: JIBRIL
cards.subtitle: The Young Flügel

tournamentAbilities.name: Thirst for Knowledge
tournamentAbilities.description: Thirst for Knowledge - Generate 1 Energy.

battleAbilities.name: Aerial Strike
battleAbilities.description: Aerial Strike - (Passive) This character deals +400 damage to characters with less than 4 EV.

cards.flavorText: “A creature that does not hunger for knowledge is no better than dust. To an immortal Flügel, a single unread book is worth more than an empire.”

cards.name: JIBRIL
cards.subtitle: Library Master

tournamentAbilities.name: Forbidden Text
tournamentAbilities.description: Forbidden Text - Generate 1 Energy. Gamble (Roll d6): (Win - 5,6) Search: A Tactic or Equipment card. (Lose - 1,2,3,4) You cannot buy Tactic or Equipment cards this turn. This effect can only be used if you are able to resolve both its Win and Lose outcomes.

battleAbilities.name: Magic Barrier
battleAbilities.description: Magic Barrier - (Passive) Reduce damage received from Active abilities by 50%.

cards.flavorText: “Every ancient scroll and grimoire in this library was won with my own hands. Step inside, and you wager your entire existence.”

cards.name: JIBRIL
cards.subtitle: God Killer

tournamentAbilities.name: Ancient War
tournamentAbilities.description: Ancient War - Generate 2 Energy. Gamble (Roll d6): (Win - 6) Destroy a card in the Market. (Lose - 1) Destroy a card in your hand.

battleAbilities.name: Divine Smite
battleAbilities.description: Divine Smite - (Active) Once per battle Gamble (Coin Flip): (Win - Heads) Deal 1000 damage. (Lose - Tails) Take 500 damage, may use again this battle.

cards.flavorText: “Before these peaceful pledges existed, these wings bathed in the blood of Old Deus. Do not mistake my current politeness for weakness.”

cards.name: JIBRIL
cards.subtitle: Winged Catastrophe

tournamentAbilities.name: Shiritori
tournamentAbilities.description: Shiritori - Attack: Generate 2 Energy. Name a card type: Opponent reveals cards with that type in their hand and discards 1 random card of that type, if any. Gamble (For each player, name a card type and look at the top card of their deck): For each correct guess, draw 1 card. For each wrong guess, your opponent draws that card.

battleAbilities.name: Heaven's Strike
battleAbilities.description: Heaven's Strike - (Active) Once per battle, your next attack deals additional damage equal to 50% of the opponent's Max HP. This character cannot attack next turn.

cards.flavorText: “Heaven’s Strike! Let the sky shatter and the earth burn to glass before the ultimate wrath of the Sixth Race!”

cards.name: CHLAMMY
cards.subtitle: The Believer

tournamentAbilities.name: Hidden Card
tournamentAbilities.description: Hidden Card - Generate 1 Energy. Gamble (Guess the top card type of your deck): (Win) Add it to your hand. (Lose) Put it on the bottom of your deck.

battleAbilities.name: Distraction
battleAbilities.description: Distraction - (Passive) Opponent has -1 EV.

cards.flavorText: “Blind hope without power is mere foolishness. I swallowed my pride and walked through the dark because survival demands sacrifice.”

cards.name: CHLAMMY
cards.subtitle: Elf Partner

tournamentAbilities.name: Rigged Game
tournamentAbilities.description: Rigged Game - Generate 1 Energy. Look at an opponent's hand and Search: a card in your deck with the same name as a card in their hand.

battleAbilities.name: Illusion Magic
battleAbilities.description: Illusion Magic - (Active) Gamble (Coin Flip): (Win - Heads) Swap your current HP with your current ATK until the end of your next turn. (Lose - Tails) Your ATK becomes 0 until the end of your turn.

cards.flavorText: “The world sees a master and an enslaved human. But between Fii and me, there is only an unbreakable pledge of shared destiny.”

cards.name: CHLAMMY
cards.subtitle: Manipulator

tournamentAbilities.name: Forced Bet
tournamentAbilities.description: Forced Bet - Generate 1 Energy. Gamble (Roll d20 vs Opponent): (Win) Steal 1 Energy from the opponent (they lose 1 on their next turn). (Lose) Give 1 Energy to the opponent (they gain 1 on their next turn).

battleAbilities.name: False Information
battleAbilities.description: False Information - (Passive) (Reserve) While in Reserve, if the opponent uses an (Active) ability, they must flip a coin. If Tails, the ability fails.

cards.flavorText: “When an opponent assumes they are playing chess, you have already won by rewriting the board inside their mind.”

cards.name: CHLAMMY & FIEL
cards.subtitle: United Race

tournamentAbilities.name: Double Agent
tournamentAbilities.description: Double Agent - Generate 2 Energy. Draw 1 card for every Pact or Spirit card in your discard pile (maximum 4 cards).

battleAbilities.name: Memory Alteration
battleAbilities.description: Memory Alteration - (Active) Twice per game, disable an opponent's ability for the rest of the game.

cards.flavorText: “Two souls unbound by racial prejudice. Combining human cunning with ancient Elven sorcery, no kingdom can tear us apart.”

cards.name: IZUNA
cards.subtitle: Cute Werebeast

tournamentAbilities.name: Play with me!
tournamentAbilities.description: Play with me! - Generate 1 Energy.

battleAbilities.name: Wild Senses
battleAbilities.description: Wild Senses - (Passive) This character gains +100 ATK against Magic (Pact/Light/Dark) characters.

cards.flavorText: “You really thought you could sneak past my fox ears and tail, desu? I already heard your heartbeat before you even took a step!”

cards.name: IZUNA
cards.subtitle: Serious Gamer

tournamentAbilities.name: Instinctive Move
tournamentAbilities.description: Instinctive Move - Attack: Generate 1 Energy. Reveal the top card of an opponent's deck; discard it or leave it on top. Gamble (before Attack; guess the card's cost): (Win) Generate +1 Energy. (Lose) Lose 1 Energy.

battleAbilities.name: Reflexes
battleAbilities.description: Reflexes - (Active) Twice per battle, this character gains +2 EV for one turn.

cards.flavorText: “Gaming isn't just fooling around, desu! The moment I grip the controller, I play to dominate every single match!”

cards.name: IZUNA
cards.subtitle: Eastern Union Champion

tournamentAbilities.name: Limit Break
tournamentAbilities.description: Limit Break - Generate 1 Energy. Gamble (4/5/6 on a d6): (Win) Generate 2 Energy. (Lose) Lose 1 Energy.

battleAbilities.name: Sixth Sense
battleAbilities.description: Sixth Sense - (Passive) If this character successfully dodges an attack, it counters for 900 damage.

cards.flavorText: “The pride and future of all Werebeasts rest on my shoulders, desu. I will never surrender our homeland to anyone!”

cards.name: IZUNA HATSUSE
cards.subtitle: Blood Destruction

tournamentAbilities.name: Overload
tournamentAbilities.description: Overload - Generate 3 Energy. You cannot buy Support cards this turn and can only buy 1 card from the Market.

battleAbilities.name: Kekkai
battleAbilities.description: Kekkai - (Active) Once per battle, attack twice. Gamble (Once per battle, Roll d6): (Win - 6: You can use Active again this battle after this gamble) (Lose - 1 to 5: Lose 2000 HP).

cards.flavorText: “Blood Destruction! Surpassing the biological limits of physical reality... In this state, not even sound can outrun my claws, desu!”

cards.name: ASCHENTE
cards.subtitle: Support Card

tournamentAbilities.name: The Pledges
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy.

battleAbilities.name: Official Challenge
battleAbilities.description: Gamble: Both players roll a d20. The player with the higher roll wins. If you win, the opponent takes 1000 damage; if you lose, you take 1000 damage; on a tie, both take 1000 damage. Discard this card after use.

cards.flavorText: “‘Aschente!’ With raised right hands and sworn oaths, all violence is stripped away. On Disboard, destiny is decided solely through games.”

cards.name: STEPHANIE'S SUPPORT
cards.subtitle: Support Card

tournamentAbilities.name: Bad Luck?
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Gamble (coin flip): (Win) Draw 1 card. (Lose) Discard 1 card.

battleAbilities.name: Clumsy Dodge
battleAbilities.description: Until the end of the next round, negate the first elemental advantage damage against you each round. If slotted with a No Game No Life character, also negate the first Lose effect of a Gamble.

cards.flavorText: “Call me a fool if you must, but I will defend my grandfather's legacy and support our sovereigns with every fiber of my being!”

cards.name: ELF ASSISTANT
cards.subtitle: Support Card

tournamentAbilities.name: Magical Buff
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 2 Energy.

battleAbilities.name: Elfic Magic
battleAbilities.description: For the next 3 combat rounds, if your Gamble would result in a Lose, you may reroll once; you must accept the second result. If slotted with Chlammy, she also gains +2 EV for the duration.

cards.flavorText: “An open grimoire of ancient Elven arcana. When invisible hexes weave through the air, victory is secured before the dice are cast.”

cards.name: SHIRO'S SMARTPHONE
cards.subtitle: Support Card

tournamentAbilities.name: Otherworldly Tech
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 2 Energy. Look at the top 2 cards of your deck and return them in any order.

battleAbilities.name: Digital Calculation
battleAbilities.description: (Attach) Attach to a character. The attached character gains this card's stats. (Passive) The attached character ignores the opponent's Passive abilities during your turn.

cards.flavorText: “A relic from another world. On this glowing screen, four characters conquered every high score: 『 』.”

cards.name: TOHSAKA TOKIOMI & GILGAMESH
cards.subtitle: Noble Heirs

tournamentAbilities.name: Elegant Treasury
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. If you have a Permanent card in play, generate +1 Energy.

battleAbilities.name: Gate of Babylon
battleAbilities.description: Twice per battle Deal 200 damage to opponent's Active Character. This damage is neutral (no elemental modifiers).

cards.flavorText: “A lineage steeped in elegance and absolute pride. Tokiomi bows with exquisite decorum, masking the tension of serving history's most arrogant king.”

cards.name: TOHSAKA TOKIOMI & GILGAMESH
cards.subtitle: Key Keepers

tournamentAbilities.name: Mage's Providence
tournamentAbilities.description: Destroy 1 card from your hand or discard pile. Search: A Bronze or Silver card. That card costs 1 less to you this round.

battleAbilities.name: Sha Nagba Imuru
battleAbilities.description: Ignore all Evasion bonuses on target when attacking.

cards.flavorText: “Holding the catalyst to the world's oldest treasury. With supreme aristocratic grace, Tokiomi orchestrates the fourth Holy Grail War from his study.”

cards.name: TOHSAKA TOKIOMI & GILGAMESH
cards.subtitle: The Golden Covenant
cards.fullName: Tohsaka Tokiomi & Gilgamesh, The Golden Covenant

tournamentAbilities.name: King's Order
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 2 Energy. You may put a card from hand to bottom of deck; if you do, draw 2.

battleAbilities.name: Enuma Elish
battleAbilities.description: Once per battle, pay 1500 HP. Deal 1200 damage to Active Character.

cards.flavorText: “‘Rejoice, Tokiomi. For my gaze alone elevates your humble lineage into legend.’ Crimson portals part, revealing Babylon's boundless armory.”

cards.name: TOHSAKA TOKIOMI & GILGAMESH
cards.subtitle: Arbiters of Victory
cards.fullName: Tohsaka Tokiomi & Gilgamesh, Arbiters of Victory

tournamentAbilities.name: Treasury of Babylon
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 2 Energy. Attack: Choose any non-Boss card from any discard pile; create a temporary copy in your hand (discard it at the end of the turn).

battleAbilities.name: Vimana Control
battleAbilities.description: Once per battle, reorder your Reserve Lineup. You may swap this card with a card in your Reserve Line. (Reserve) Command Seal: Pay 1000 HP from your Active Character to swap it with another card in your Reserve Line.

cards.flavorText: “A master of flame sorcery backed by the unmatched majesty of the King of Heroes. When Gilgamesh opens the Gate of Babylon, no mortal can stand.”

cards.name: TOHSAKA TOKIOMI & GILGAMESH
cards.subtitle: King of Heroes
cards.fullName: Tohsaka Tokiomi & Gilgamesh, King of Heroes

tournamentAbilities.name: Genesis of All Things
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 3 Energy. Reveal the top card of your deck. If it is Silver, Gold, Diamond, or Boss, add it to your hand.

battleAbilities.name: Ea: Sword of Rupture
battleAbilities.description: Once per game, charge for 2 rounds (no attack or Active abilities). Then deal 2000 damage to all enemy characters (Active + Reserve Line). If you receive Stun, Sleep, Confuse, or Disarm, cancel the charge. Command Seal: Pay 1000 HP to become immune to Stun, Sleep, Confuse, and Disarm while charging.

cards.flavorText: “‘Who gave you permission to look upon me, mongrel?’ Turning the sky gold with uncounted Noble Phantasms, the ancient sovereign claims all creation as his garden.”

cards.name: EMIYA KIRITSUGU & ARTHORIA
cards.subtitle: Unlikely Pair

tournamentAbilities.name: Practical Tactics
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Look at top deck; may put on bottom.

battleAbilities.name: Invisible Air
battleAbilities.description: Once per battle Deal 400 damage. Target loses 400 ATK until your next round start.

cards.flavorText: “An assassin who scorns glory paired with a legendary monarch sworn to chivalry. Two broken souls chasing the same miracle down irreconcilable paths.”

cards.name: EMIYA KIRITSUGU & ARTHORIA
cards.subtitle: Sword and Gun
cards.fullName: Emiya Kiritsugu & Arthoria, Sword and Gun

tournamentAbilities.name: Time Alter
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Attack: Discard 1 card; target opponent discards 1 random card.

battleAbilities.name: Mana Burst
battleAbilities.description: If your next attack hits, also deal 700 direct damage (ignores EV).

cards.flavorText: “While the King of Knights cuts through darkness with Invisible Air, the Magus Killer measures wind drift and bullet trajectories through night-vision scopes.”

cards.name: EMIYA KIRITSUGU & ARTHORIA
cards.subtitle: Ideals Collide

tournamentAbilities.name: Origin Bullet
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Defense: Play this card to avoid the attack. This card stays in play until end of yourn turn.

battleAbilities.name: Excalibur
battleAbilities.description: Once per battle, pay 1000 HP. Deal 1200 damage. If defeat, heal 500 HP. Command Seal: Pay +1000 HP, deal +1000 damage.

cards.flavorText: “‘Heroes are merely murderers wrapped in pretty words.’ Kiritsugu’s cold pragmatism shatters Artoria’s chivalric oath, leaving only the grim duty of survival.”

cards.name: EMIYA KIRITSUGU & ARTHORIA
cards.subtitle: King of Knights
cards.fullName: Emiya Kiritsugu & Arthoria, King of Knights

tournamentAbilities.name: Avalon
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 2 Energy. At end of turn after drawing, shuffle 1 card from discard into deck.

battleAbilities.name: Scabbard's Blessing
battleAbilities.description: When you deal damage with (Active) effects, heal 500 HP of Active Character.

cards.flavorText: “‘Let the light of humanity gather upon this sacred steel!’ Raising Excalibur high into the crimson night, the King of Knights banishes all despair.”

cards.name: THE HOLY GRAIL'S BURDEN
cards.subtitle: Support Card
cards.fullName: The Holy Grail's Burden, Support Card

tournamentAbilities.name: Desire for Miracle
tournamentAbilities.description: Destroy up to 2 cards from your hand.

battleAbilities.name: Sacred Defense
battleAbilities.description: Once per game, negate an incoming attack that deals 1400 damage or less.

cards.flavorText: “A wish-granting vessel forged in blood and betrayal. Beneath its radiant promise of miracles lies an agonizing toll no human heart can endure.”

cards.name: KOTOMINE KIREI & HUNDRED FACES
cards.subtitle: The Hidden
cards.fullName: Kotomine Kirei & Hundred Faces, The Hidden

tournamentAbilities.name: Zabaniya: Stealth
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Look at bottom of deck; keep or discard.

battleAbilities.name: Swarm Tactics
battleAbilities.description: For each other "Hundred Faces" in Reserve, +200 ATK (max +600).

cards.flavorText: “In the confessional booth of Fuyuki Church, the empty executor seeks purpose in prayer—yet only cold shadows whisper back through the stained glass.”

cards.name: KOTOMINE KIREI & HUNDRED FACES
cards.subtitle: Disfigured Shadows
cards.fullName: Kotomine Kirei & Hundred Faces, Disfigured Shadows

tournamentAbilities.name: Answering the Call
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Search a "Kotomine Kirei & Hundred Faces" card; it costs 2 less this round.

battleAbilities.name: For We Are Many
battleAbilities.description: For each other "Hundred Faces" in Reserve, first attack of your active character each battle ignores 1 EV.

cards.flavorText: “Eighty souls bound into one fractured servant. Scouting through rooftops and dark alleys, the Hassan puppets feed Kirei the secrets of the Holy Grail War.”

cards.name: KOTOMINE KIREI & HUNDRED FACES
cards.subtitle: Legion of the Lost
cards.fullName: Kotomine Kirei & Hundred Faces, Legion of the Lost

tournamentAbilities.name: Only the strongest
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Search: a card with 1500+ Atk.

battleAbilities.name: Assassination
battleAbilities.description: Once per battle Deal ATK damage on the active character. If this damage kill the target, you may swap this card with another card.

cards.flavorText: “Discarded expendables sacrificed to illuminate the stage. Every masked face that falls only brings Kotomine closer to awakening his true nature.”

tournamentAbilities.description: You may destroy a card from your hand to generate 2 Energy. Opponents may also do this after you.

battleAbilities.name: Angra Mainyu
battleAbilities.description: Negate all Active Character effects while this card is active. This effect lasts for 3 rounds.

cards.flavorText: “All the World's Evil seeps through fractured gold. The black mud of Angra Mainyu consumes holy prayers and rebirths them into primordial annihilation.”

cards.name: WAVER VELVET & ISKANDER
cards.subtitle: Student and King
cards.fullName: Waver Velvet & Iskander, Student and King

tournamentAbilities.name: Strategic Genius
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Pay 1 to rearrange top 3 of deck.

battleAbilities.name: Gordius Wheel
battleAbilities.description: Once per battle, reveal opponent's Reserve with lowest HP, deal 300 damage. If tie, deal to all tied.

cards.flavorText: “A timid Clock Tower novice clutching a stolen relic, suddenly face-to-face with a mountain of a man who laughs in the face of destiny.”

cards.name: WAVER VELVET & ISKANDER
cards.subtitle: Marching to Battle
cards.fullName: Waver Velvet & Iskander, Marching to Battle

tournamentAbilities.name: Charisma of the Conqueror
tournamentAbilities.description: Discard a non-residual Energy card. Generate 2 Energy.

battleAbilities.name: Ionioi Hetairoi
battleAbilities.description: Create a Soldier token (200 HP, 300 ATK, EV 3) at the bottom of your Reserve.

cards.flavorText: “‘To be a king means to live more passionately and greedily than any other!’ Iskander’s roar dispels Waver’s insecurities with every thunderous step.”

cards.name: WAVER VELVET & ISKANDER
cards.subtitle: Army of the King
cards.fullName: Waver Velvet & Iskander, Army of the King

tournamentAbilities.name: Rider's Scouting
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Search a Support card; it costs 2 less this round.

battleAbilities.name: Zeus's Thunder
battleAbilities.description: Once per game, your lowest HP unit and opponent's lowest HP unit hit each other (no dodge).

cards.flavorText: “‘Glory lies beyond the horizon!’ A barren desert sweeps across reality, summoning millions of loyal soldiers marching beneath the banner of conquerors.”

cards.name: WAVER VELVET & ISKANDER
cards.subtitle: King of Conquerors
cards.fullName: Waver Velvet & Iskander, King of Conquerors

tournamentAbilities.name: Via Expugnatio
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 3 Energy. Pay 2 Energy to search for any "Fate/Zero" or "Waver & Iskander" card.

battleAbilities.name: Herd of Divine Bulls
battleAbilities.description: Once per battle, create a Soldier Token. (Passive) Whenever you defeat a character, the characters with the lowest current HP on each player's side attack each other (no Evasion).

cards.flavorText: “‘Live on, Waver. Bear witness to my conquest, and tell my tale to the world.’ Charging fearless into Babylonian blades with the noble heart of a king.”

cards.name: GORDIUS WHEEL
cards.subtitle: Support Card

tournamentAbilities.name: Reality Marble Seed
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. If 3 or more different Support cards are in your discard pile, draw 1 card.

battleAbilities.name: Dynamis
battleAbilities.description: (Attach) Attach to any character; the attached character gains this card's stats. (Passive) The equipped character loses 1000 maximum HP (minimum 1). When the bearer attacks, deal 150 damage to all enemy Reserve characters.

cards.flavorText: “Divine bulls trampling through thunderclouds, pulling the sacred war chariot across the sky with lightning crackling from its iron wheels.”

cards.name: THE BOOK OF FALSE ATTENDANT
cards.subtitle: Support Card

tournamentAbilities.name: Forbidden Ritual
tournamentAbilities.description: Tutor: Choose any card from your deck and add it to your hand.

battleAbilities.name: Jeanne's Desecration
battleAbilities.description: Choose one effect to apply to the opponent's Active Character: Burn (3 turns) or Bleeding (2 turns). Command Seal: Pay 1000 HP to apply both instead.

cards.flavorText: “Bound in human skin, the ancient grimoire breathes forbidden abyssal verses that corrupt the mind and summon grotesque horrors from beyond.”

cards.name: ERNESTI
cards.subtitle: Silhouette Crafter

tournamentAbilities.name: Blueprints
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Search: An Equipment Support card.

battleAbilities.name: Basic Spell
battleAbilities.description: This character gains +200 ATK for each Equipment attached to it.

cards.flavorText: “In my previous life, I was just a programmer who dreamed of giant robots. In this world, magic is real—and I will build the greatest mecha the world has ever seen!”

cards.name: ERNESTI
cards.subtitle: Knight Runner

tournamentAbilities.name: Rapid Prototyping
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 2 Energy. May pay 1 Energy to Search: eQUIPMENT

battleAbilities.name: Direct Control
battleAbilities.description: Once per battle: Deal 500 damage. Overclock: Deal 1000 damage instead, and next attack ignores Evasion.

cards.flavorText: “Rewriting the ancient magical scripts like lines of code. When you treat mana flow as software architecture, the impossible becomes routine.”

cards.name: ERNESTI
cards.subtitle: Order Commander

tournamentAbilities.name: Reverse Engineering
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 2 Energy. Destroy: A card from your hand or discard pile. You may Search: a Card with the destroyed card Type. (Tactic, Equipment etc are Types)

battleAbilities.name: Mana Conversion
battleAbilities.description: Each time you successfully hit the opponent, gain 1 Mana counter. At 3 counters, heal 1000 HP, recover an Equipment Card from your discard to your lineup and remove all counters.

cards.flavorText: “Commanding the Silver Phoenix Knights isn't just a military honor. It's the ultimate workshop where imagination takes physical steel form.”

cards.name: ERNESTI ECHEVALIER
cards.subtitle: Creator of Ikaruga

tournamentAbilities.name: Unprecedented Design
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 2 Energy. You may: Retain (2) or create a copy of a Equipment card on your hand/discard and shuffle it on your deck.

battleAbilities.name: Four-Armed Rush
battleAbilities.description: Once per game deal 1000 Damage by each Equipment Attached to this card. Overclock: Deal 2000 Damage Instead.

cards.flavorText: “Behold Ikaruga! Twin Ether Reactors, four sub-arms, and the Maneuver Thrusters of the gods. Science and sorcery united into pure mechanical perfection!”

cards.name: ERNESTI ECHEVALIER
cards.subtitle: Demon of the Sky
cards.fullName: Ernesti Echevalier, Demon of the Sky

tournamentAbilities.name: Magius Engine Maximized
tournamentAbilities.description: (Permanent) Search: Equipment Name. Every Equipment card costs 1 less to you.

battleAbilities.name: Ikaruga's Craft
battleAbilities.description: For each Equipment attached to this card, deal 150 damage to the opponent's Active Character when attacking. (Passive) If you defeat an opponent's character, you may recover an Equipment from any discard pile and attach it to this card, ignoring the maximum Support slot limit. Overclock: For each card discarded by this effect, heal 500 HP.

cards.flavorText: “They call me the Demon of the Sky... but I just really, truly love robots! Stand against my creations, and prepare to face a storm of unbridled innovation!”

cards.name: ADELTRUD
cards.subtitle: Energetic Trainee

tournamentAbilities.name: Cheer Up!
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. React: When an opponent uses an Attack keyword, you may discard this card from your hand to draw 1 card.

battleAbilities.name: Cover Fire
battleAbilities.description: While in the reserve line, your Active character gains +1 EV.

cards.flavorText: “Wherever Eru goes, I'm following right behind! Even if it means climbing inside an iron giant and kicking giant monsters in the face!”

cards.name: ADELTRUD
cards.subtitle: Twin Pilot

tournamentAbilities.name: Tag Team
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. If you played another “Knights & Magic” character this turn, draw a card.

battleAbilities.name: Combined Assault
battleAbilities.description: Deal 400 damage to the opponent's Active character. Overclock: Swap after your next attack.

cards.flavorText: “Two pilots, one heart! In the cockpit with Kid, my instincts guide our strikes while he handles the stride.”

cards.name: ADELTRUD
cards.subtitle: Earlcumber's Vanguard

tournamentAbilities.name: Defensive Formation
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Defend: Reveal this card and Discard another card from your hand.

battleAbilities.name: Shield Bash
battleAbilities.description: Once per game, deal 400 damage and apply Stun to the target. May target a card on Reserve.

cards.flavorText: “Vanguard charge! Let them throw all the demonic beasts they want; as long as I have my hands on the control rods, no one touches my friends!”

cards.name: ADDY
cards.subtitle: Heart of the Knight

tournamentAbilities.name: Unwavering Support
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Search: Knights & Magic character that character cost 3 less to you.

battleAbilities.name: Armor Purge
battleAbilities.description: Once per battle, you can recover a Equipment from your discard and slot it in your Active or Reserve character with a Empty Slot. Overclock: Choose a defeated Character in your line: Revive it and heal 500 HP For each card discarded by this effect.

cards.flavorText: “Don't underestimate a girl in love! When Eru's dream is on the line, my machine will smash through any fortress or army!”

cards.name: ARCHID
cards.subtitle: Eager Student

tournamentAbilities.name: Quick Step
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. React: If you are attack, you may play this card, it stays in play until the end of your round and generates 2 energy instead.

battleAbilities.name: Dash Attack
battleAbilities.description: Gain +300 ATK until your next attack, max 5.

cards.flavorText: “Learning magic from Eru makes your head spin, but the results speak for themselves. I'm going to be a Knight Runner nobody can look down on!”

cards.name: ARCHID
cards.subtitle: Centaur Pilot

tournamentAbilities.name: Hit and Run
tournamentAbilities.description: Once per turn, if this card's Attack succeeds, repeat it against another target. Attack: Your opponent may draw a card; you generate 2 Energy. Attack: Your opponent discards a card; you generate 1 Energy.

battleAbilities.name: Flanking Maneuver
battleAbilities.description: This character's next attack cannot be dodged. Cooldown: 1 Round.

cards.flavorText: “Four legs beat two every single day of the week. Galloping through enemy lines on a centaur-type frame feels like riding thunder!”

cards.name: ARCHID
cards.subtitle: Tzendolg Rider

tournamentAbilities.name: Dog Reconnaissance
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Reveal the top 5 cards of the Market Deck; You may replace the Market Line with any of these cards.

battleAbilities.name: Jousting Charge
battleAbilities.description: Each time this character attacks, Gain 1 Ev, lose all stacks when miss an attack. Overclock: Dont Lose Stacks until the end of you next round.

cards.flavorText: “Tzendolg, full speed ahead! We break through the siege, flank the cannons, and leave nothing behind but dust and spent cartridges.”

cards.name: KID
cards.subtitle: The Silver Gale

tournamentAbilities.name: Speed over Armor
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 2 Energy. Draw 2 cards. You cannot use Defend/Defense until the start of your next turn.

battleAbilities.name: Gale Strike
battleAbilities.description: Once per game, deal 1500 damage to the opponent's Active Character. Overclock: Repeat this character's (Active) effect.

cards.flavorText: “The Silver Gale cutting across the battlefield! Hand-in-hand with my sister, our twin synchronization turns steel into a deadly dance.”

cards.name: EDGAR
cards.subtitle: Senior Knight

tournamentAbilities.name: Honor Bound
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 3 Energy. you must buy an ACB card with this round.

battleAbilities.name: Shield Wall
battleAbilities.description: This character takes 100 less damage from all incoming attacks. If you have an equipment attached, reduce 200 more.

cards.flavorText: “A Knight Runner's first duty is not glory—it is the survival of his comrades. Discipline and training forge an unbreakable line.”

cards.name: EDGAR
cards.subtitle: Earlcumber's Master

tournamentAbilities.name: Tactical Stand
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Search: A card with the Defend keyword.

battleAbilities.name: Defensive Stance
battleAbilities.description: Double this character's EV for the opponent's next attack. Halve your attack.

cards.flavorText: “Earlcumber stands firm! Behind this massive shield of steel and mana, the knights of Fremmevira know no fear.”

cards.name: EDGAR
cards.subtitle: The White Knight

tournamentAbilities.name: Knight's Vow
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Defend: Once per turn, you may reveal this card from your hand to defend any attack on any target. Generate 1 Energy that lasts until the end of your turn.

battleAbilities.name: Ardi Radcumber's Shield
battleAbilities.description: When this character is your Active character, your characters in Reserve cannot take damage. Overclock: Negate an incoming attack entirely.

cards.flavorText: “Even when outnumbered a hundred to one, the White Knight does not yield an inch. Our honor is as unyielding as our armor.”

cards.name: EDGAR C. BLANCHE
cards.subtitle: Shield of the Order
cards.fullName: Edgar C. Blanche, Shield of the Order

tournamentAbilities.name: Impenetrable Formation
tournamentAbilities.description: (Permanent) Generate 1 Energy. Once per turn, you may Defend: Generate 1 Energy.

battleAbilities.name: Absolute Defense
battleAbilities.description: (At Start of game) Reveal this card from your Lineup. Your first character gains a 1000 HP Shield. Overclock: (Reserve)(Active) Your Active Character gain 1000 Shield.

cards.flavorText: “I am the fortress that shelters the Silver Phoenix Order. Break your blades against my resolve, for this shield shall never shatter!”

cards.name: DIETRICH
cards.subtitle: Arrogant Noble

tournamentAbilities.name: Bragging Rights
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 2 Energy or Draw a card, next round lose 2 Energy (Can go negative)

battleAbilities.name: Reckless Missile
battleAbilities.description: Once per Game Deal 600 damage, but this character takes 200 damage. For each Equipment attached, deal 100 more damage.

cards.flavorText: “High blood and supreme pride meant nothing when staring into the jaws of a Behemoth. True strength begins only after you confront your own cowardice.”

cards.name: DIETRICH
cards.subtitle: Humbled Warrior

tournamentAbilities.name: Noble Advantage
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. You may pay 2 Energy to Search: A "Knights e Magic" Equipment. If you was attacked last round, you dont need to pay.

battleAbilities.name: Focused Blade
battleAbilities.description: For each equipmment attached to this card, Ignore 1 EV from your opponent on Normal Attacks.

cards.flavorText: “Humility earned through bitter defeat. Now, every swing of my blade is honed by the determination never to turn my back on fear again.”

cards.name: DIETRICH
cards.subtitle: Guair's Pilot

tournamentAbilities.name: Dual Wielding
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Retain (1). Attack: One opponent discards a card. You may repeat this Attack each time you play an Equipment card this turn.

battleAbilities.name: Cross Slash
battleAbilities.description: Once per Game, for each Equipment Attached to this card, attack one more time this turn.

cards.flavorText: “Guair unleashed! Charging ahead as the spearpoint of retribution, where aggressive melee maneuvers overpower any foe's defenses.”

cards.name: DIETRICH KNITZ
cards.subtitle: The Crimson Flash

tournamentAbilities.name: Crimson Comet
tournamentAbilities.description: With each successful attack this round, generate 1 energy. Attack: The target opponent discards 2 random cards.

battleAbilities.name: Arondight's Wrath
battleAbilities.description: Each time this character successfully dodges an attack, its next attack that hits deals +500 damage, up to +1000 damage. Overclock: Ignore 3 of your opponent's EV this turn for the next attack.

cards.flavorText: “The Crimson Flash streaks across the sky! With twin swords ignited by roaring combustion engines, my strike strikes true and final!”

cards.name: SILHOUETTE GEAR
cards.subtitle: Support Card

tournamentAbilities.name: Basic Rigging
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy.

battleAbilities.name: Mobility Assist
battleAbilities.description: (Attach) Attach to a character. The attached character gains this card's stats and ignores Disarm effects.

cards.flavorText: “A revolutionary miniature exoskeleton that turns mortal flesh into supercharged muscle, paving the way for the next generation of Knight Runners.”

cards.name: MAGICAL MUSKET
cards.subtitle: Support Card

tournamentAbilities.name: Cavalry Charge
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy each time you Search or draw cards, up to 2 Energy.

battleAbilities.name: Trample
battleAbilities.description: (Attach) Attach to a character. If the attached character's attack defeats an enemy, the remaining excess damage is dealt to the next character in the opponent's lineup.

cards.flavorText: “Condensing explosive combustion spells into rapid-fire kinetic slugs. A single marksman can now puncture heavy steel plating from leagues away.”

cards.name: TWIN PILOTS
cards.subtitle: Support Card

tournamentAbilities.name: Weapon Mastery
tournamentAbilities.description: Search for a card with the Attack keyword. That card costs 1 less.

battleAbilities.name: Blade Flurry
battleAbilities.description: (Attach) Attach to a character. The attached character gains this card's stats. If the attached character uses an Active ability, it gains +300 ATK until the end of the round.

cards.flavorText: “Splitting control between propulsion and artillery through twin-cockpit synergy. When fraternal harmony guides the machine, its efficiency doubles.”

cards.name: ARDI'S TOWER SHIELD
cards.subtitle: Support Card

tournamentAbilities.name: Heavy Plating
tournamentAbilities.description: Defend: Discard this card.

battleAbilities.name: Phalanx
battleAbilities.description: (Attach) Attach to a character. The attached character gains this card's stats and is immune to Bleeding and Burn.

cards.flavorText: “A colossal wall of reinforced alloy and warding hexes. Under its sheltering shadow, entire squadrons weather the fury of cannonfire unscathed.”

cards.name: GON
cards.subtitle: Innocent Challenger

tournamentAbilities.name: Instinctive Boy
tournamentAbilities.description: React: When an opponent uses an Attack keyword or declares an attack, you may reveal this card from your hand to draw 1 card (Max 2 times per round).

battleAbilities.name: Fishing Rod
battleAbilities.description: Target 1 character in the opponent's Reserve line; move it 1 slot up. It may immediately swap positions with the opponent's Active Character.

cards.flavorText: “Armed with his father’s fishing rod and a bottomless well of optimism, the boy from Whale Island dives headfirst into the Hunter Exam.”

cards.name: GON
cards.subtitle: Determined Rookie

tournamentAbilities.name: Nen: Ten
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Look at the top 5 cards of an opponent's deck; you may place any Attack cards found this way on either the top or bottom of their deck in any order.

battleAbilities.name: Nen: Ren
battleAbilities.description: Gain a 400 HP Shield and +100 ATK for the rest of this battle. Nen 3: Trigger this character's (Enter) effect an additional time.

cards.flavorText: “Pushing open the heavy gates of Kukuroo Mountain and training tirelessly at Heavens Arena. His spirit never breaks, even when beaten black and blue.”

battleAbilities.description: Once per game: [Gu ✊] - This character's next attack gains +1000 ATK, but the target character gains +2 EV against it. Nen 6: Recharge this character's (Active) skill.

cards.flavorText: “First comes rock... Jajanken: Gu!”

tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. When you play this card, choose one stance for the round: [Ko], [Ken], or [Shu]. battleAbilities.description: Once per game: [Po ✋] - This character's next attack can target any character in the opponent's Reserve line. Nen 6: Recharge this character's (Active) skill.

cards.flavorText: “Emitting nen into an explosive ranged blast... Jajanken: Po!”

tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. When you play this card, choose one stance for the round: [Ko], [Ken], or [Shu]. battleAbilities.description: Once per game: [Chi ✌️] - This character's next attack completely ignores 2 EV of the target character. Nen 6: Recharge this character's (Active) skill.

cards.flavorText: “Transmuting aura into a razor-sharp blade... Jajanken: Chi!”

cards.name: GON FREECSS
cards.subtitle: Silent Wrath

tournamentAbilities.name: Show Me Kaito
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 2 Energy. Attack: Target opponent must reveal their hand. If they do not reveal a card with a Defend/Defense, they must discard their entire hand. This ability cannot be Defend or React effects.

battleAbilities.name: Vow My Life
battleAbilities.description: Once per game, gain +1000 Max HP and +1000 ATK, but lose -4 EV (heal this character for 1000 HP when Max HP increases). At the end of this battle, destroy this character wherever it is located and remove it from the game entirely (it cannot be revived).

cards.flavorText: “All cheerful warmth drained away, replaced by an abyss of bottomless rage. Facing Pitou, the boy chooses to throw away everything.”

cards.name: GON FREECSS
cards.subtitle: The End of Hope
cards.fullName: Gon Freecss, The End of Hope

tournamentAbilities.name: I... will kill you...
tournamentAbilities.description: Attack (Max 3 times per turn): Target opponent discards a card at random. Each time an opponent discards a card due to this effect, choose one: Generate 1 Energy; or Destroy 1 card from your hand or discard pile.

battleAbilities.name: The End of Hope
battleAbilities.description: At the start of your turn, this character loses 2000 HP. (Enter) Once per game, this character gains +2000 Max HP for each of your characters already defeated in this battle (heal for the same amount). Nen 8: Trigger this character's (Enter) effect an additional time.

cards.flavorText: “‘I don’t care if this is the end... so I’ll use everything.’ An adult body born of ultimate despair, shattering gods with blows of apocalyptic consequence.”

cards.name: KILLUA
cards.subtitle: Heir of Assassins

tournamentAbilities.name: Killer Instinct
tournamentAbilities.description: For each successful attack that hit an opponent during the previous tournament round, generate 1 Energy (Max 2 Energy per turn).

battleAbilities.name: Killer Stab
battleAbilities.description: Deal 400 damage to the opponent's Active Character (this damage can trigger element advantages).

cards.flavorText: “Trained from birth in torture, poison, and execution. Beneath his mischievous grin lies an assassin capable of plucking out a heart in a blink.”

cards.name: KILLUA
cards.subtitle: Loyal Companion

tournamentAbilities.name: Skateboard
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. If you landed a successful attack that hit an opponent during the previous tournament round, draw 1 card.

battleAbilities.name: Razor Nails
battleAbilities.description: Successful attacks that hit an opponent apply Bleeding (2 Turns).

cards.flavorText: “Walking beside Gon, Killua learns the meaning of a true friend. For the first time, he fights not because he was ordered to, but because he wants to protect.”

cards.name: KILLUA
cards.subtitle: High Voltz

tournamentAbilities.name: Izutsuchi
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. React: Reveal this card from your hand when an opponent draws a card due to a card effect; negate that draw, and that opponent cannot draw cards through card effects for the rest of this turn (Once per round).

battleAbilities.name: Narukami
battleAbilities.description: Once per battle, deal 700 damage. If this attack has an elemental advantage against the target, double the damage and apply Stun (1 Turn). Nen 4: Recharge this character's (Active) skill.

cards.flavorText: “Transmuting his aura into high-voltage electricity! Electric currents course through his veins, numbing enemies with every paralyzing touch.”

cards.name: KILLUA ZOLDYCK
cards.subtitle: Godspeed Mode

tournamentAbilities.name: Godspeed: Shippu Jinrai
tournamentAbilities.description: Permanent: Generate 1 Energy. Negate the first Attack keyword used against you each turn; the player who used it must discard 1 card from their hand.

battleAbilities.name: Godspeed: Denko Sekka
battleAbilities.description: You may attack twice this turn. (Active) Twice per game, swap this character's position with a character in your Reserve line. Nen 5: Gain 1 additional activation of this character's (Active) skill.

cards.flavorText: “Godspeed: Shippu Jinrai! Transmitting nerve signals as pure lightning, his reflexes bypass conscious thought to achieve impossible velocity.”

cards.name: KURAPIKA
cards.subtitle: Last of the Kurta

tournamentAbilities.name: Kurta Survivor
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Defend: Discard this card from your hand to draw 1 card.

battleAbilities.name: Avenger’s Will
battleAbilities.description: Your attacks deal +300 additional damage if the target has defeated a character from your Lineup during this battle. This damage ignores all shields, damage reduction, and elemental interactions.

cards.flavorText: “The sole survivor of a slaughtered clan. Behind his composed demeanor lies an eternity of grief burning for retribution against the Phantom Troupe.”

cards.name: KURAPIKA
cards.subtitle: Blacklist Hunter

tournamentAbilities.name: Bounty Hunt
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Attack: Target opponent reveals 1 random card from their hand; Search: 1 card from the Market Deck that shares a first name with the revealed card.

battleAbilities.name: Spider Slayer
battleAbilities.description: This character's attacks ignore 2 EV of Dark element characters.

cards.flavorText: “Donning the suit of a bodyguard in the criminal underworld of Yorknew. Five chains dangle from his fingers, each bound to a lethal purpose.”

cards.name: KURAPIKA
cards.subtitle: Avenger's Resolve

tournamentAbilities.name: Dousing Chain
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Search: A random card belonging to any specific Universe.

battleAbilities.name: Chain Jail
battleAbilities.description: Once per game, apply [Bind] to the opponent's Active Character. (Passive) Characters with Bind cannot declare attacks; the controlling player must roll an 11 or higher on a d20 at the start of their turn to remove the Bind status. Nen 6: Trigger this character's (Enter) effect an additional time.

cards.flavorText: “‘A condition etched into my heart, with death as the price of violation.’ Chain Jail tightens around the Spiders, forcing them into absolute Zetsu.”

cards.name: KURAPIKA
cards.subtitle: Emperor Time

tournamentAbilities.name: All Nen Types
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 2 Energy. Search: A card belonging to any chosen Element.

battleAbilities.name: Specialization Nen: Emperor Time
battleAbilities.description: Once per battle, change one of this character's Elements to any other Element for the remainder of this battle. Nen 4: Recharge this character's (Active) skill.

cards.flavorText: “When his eyes glow crimson scarlet, Emperor Time awakens—granting 100% mastery over every nen category at the cost of his own lifespan.”

cards.name: LEORIO
cards.subtitle: Aspiring Doctor

tournamentAbilities.name: Money for Medicine
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. You may pay 1 Energy to shuffle 1 card from your discard pile into your deck.

battleAbilities.name: First Aid
battleAbilities.description: Once per battle, reveal this card from your Reserve line to heal your Active Character for 800 HP. Nen 3: Hide this character.

cards.flavorText: “Loud, stubborn, and dressed in a cheap business suit. He claims he only wants money, but his true dream is to heal the poor without charging a single cent.”

cards.name: LEORIO
cards.subtitle: Reliable Ally

tournamentAbilities.name: Empathic Doctor
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Defend: Shuffle 1 card from your discard pile into your deck, then discard this card from your hand.
