0087.flavorText: “Serving black tea with flawless etiquette and a sinister smirk. There is no task too trivial—or execution too bloody—for his revered master Rimuru.”

0088.name: DIABLO
0088.subtitle: Demon Noble

tournamentAbilities.name: For My Lord
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Search: Rimuru.

battleAbilities.name: Lord's Protection
battleAbilities.description: If you have a "Rimuru" card in your Lineup (active or reserve), this character gains +300 ATK and +2 EV (Not Stack). Skill Learn.

0088.flavorText: “To offend Lord Rimuru is to invite an eternity of exquisite despair. The demon noble smiles gently as he peels your soul into shreds.”

0089.name: DIABLO
0089.subtitle: Primordial Noir

tournamentAbilities.name: Scheming
tournamentAbilities.description: Permanent: Once per turn, when an opponent uses a Recruitment keyword, draw 1 card.

battleAbilities.name: End of World
battleAbilities.description: Once per game, this character gains +100 ATK for each Attack card in all discard piles. Skill Learn.

0089.flavorText: “The architect of despair weaves Temptation World across the battlefield. Within his illusionary domain, reality bends and non-believers cease to exist.”

0090.name: BENIMARU
0090.subtitle: Ogre Warrior

tournamentAbilities.name: Ogre Tactics
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. You may reveal a Fighter card from your hand. If you do, draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.

battleAbilities.name: Flame Slash
battleAbilities.description: Twice per battle, this character's next attack deals +150 damage.

0090.flavorText: “Carrying the blazing pride of a fallen clan, the young ogre prince grips his katana with fierce resolve to avenge his slaughtered kin.”

0091.name: BENIMARU
0091.subtitle: Kijin Commander

tournamentAbilities.name: General's Orders
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. The next Fighter card you buy this turn can be placed on top of your deck.

battleAbilities.name: Cleaving Strike
battleAbilities.description: When this character's attack defeats an enemy, deal damage equal to half this card's ATK to the next character in the opponent's Lineup. Skill Learn.

0091.flavorText: “Blessed with a new name and evolved into noble Kijin nobility, he commands the vanguard of the Jura Tempest Federation with calm authority.”

0092.name: BENIMARU
0092.subtitle: Samurai General

tournamentAbilities.name: Battlefield Tactics
tournamentAbilities.description: Attack: Chose a recruitment Keyword and look at the 2 top cards of each opponent, discard all cards with that keyword. Then, generate 1 Energy.

battleAbilities.name: Commander's Aura
battleAbilities.description: Once per game, other Fighter and Dark characters in your Lineup gain +200 ATK and HP. Skill Learn.

0092.flavorText: “A supreme general who reads the ebb and flow of warfare like a shogi board. His fiery command turns ordinary warriors into an unstoppable legion.”

0093.name: BENIMARU
0093.subtitle: Flare Lord

tournamentAbilities.name: Scorched Earth
tournamentAbilities.description: Attack: Generate 2 Energy. Choose two Recruitment keywords. Each opponent discards all cards with either chosen keyword.

battleAbilities.name: Black Flame
battleAbilities.description: Once per battle, this character's next attack deals +500 damage and applies Burn for 3 turns. The target cannot use Defensive abilities against this attack. Skill Learn.

0093.flavorText: “Crowned as the Flare Lord among Rimuru's Twelve Patrons! When his dark inferno ignites, Hellflare consumes entire armies without leaving a speck of ash.”

0094.name: SOUEI
0094.subtitle: Ogre Assassin

tournamentAbilities.name: Shadow Return
tournamentAbilities.description: You may place one of your played cards this turn that has a Recruitment keyword on top of your deck instead of the discard pile.

battleAbilities.name: Shadow Step
battleAbilities.description: Once per battle, swap this character with the next character on your Reserve Line.

0094.flavorText: “Silent footsteps through moonlit foliage. The ogre shadow stalks unseen, striking lethal blows before the rustle of leaves can even register.”

0095.name: SOUEI
0095.subtitle: Kijin Spy

tournamentAbilities.name: Espionage
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Search: Cost 2 or 1

battleAbilities.name: Clone
battleAbilities.description: Once per game, create a perfect copy of this Attack card and set that copy as the next character in the formation. It consumes no reserve space, but has only 1 HP and 5 EV. You and him gain Substitution. (Passive) Substitution: At start of each turn, you may swap with your clone.

0095.flavorText: “Multiplying his presence through intangible shadow clones. To Souei, every whisper and footfall in the Great Jura Forest is an open book.”

0096.name: SOUEI
0096.subtitle: Master of Espionage

tournamentAbilities.name: Intelligence Report
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Choose an opponent reveal their hand; Search: A recruitment Keyword on that opponent hand.

battleAbilities.name: Assassin's Strike
battleAbilities.description: This character's attacks ignore 50% of the enemy's EV stat (rounded down). Skill Learn.

0096.flavorText: “Behind calm, sapphire eyes lies an interrogation master from whom no secret can hide. To be ensnared in his net is to surrender one's fate.”

0097.name: SOUEI
0097.subtitle: Shadow of Rimuru

tournamentAbilities.name: Ambush
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 2 Energy. Attack: An opponent discards 1 card. React: When an opponent buys a card costing 6 or more, you may reveal this card from your hand to generate 2 Energy.

battleAbilities.name: Steel String Manipulation
battleAbilities.description: When an opponent's Attack card enters battle, apply Bleeding for 4 turns. Skill Learn.

0097.flavorText: “Operating within the deepest shadows of the Demon Lord's court. His razor-sharp steel threads slice through armored knights and mythical beasts alike.”

0098.name: DEMON LORD'S BLESSING
0098.subtitle: Support Card

tournamentAbilities.name: Dark Pact
tournamentAbilities.description: (Permanent) Discard a card with a Recruitment keyword from your hand. Search for a card with that keyword; the searched card costs less based on the discarded card's rarity: Bronze -1, Silver -2, Gold -3, Diamond -4, Boss -6.

battleAbilities.name: Skill Grant
battleAbilities.description: (Attach) Attach to any character. The attached character gains this card's stats and the Skill Learn keyword.

0098.flavorText: “When a True Demon Lord awakens, the Harvest Festival bestows divine evolutionary gifts across the soul corridor, blessing loyal retainers with transcendent power.”

0099.name: DRAGO-NOVA
0099.subtitle: Support Card

tournamentAbilities.name: Ultimate Magic
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 3 Energy.

battleAbilities.name: Cataclysm
battleAbilities.description: Activate this card slotted with any character. Deal 3000 damage to the opponent's Active Character; you must roll to attack. Discard this card after use.

0099.flavorText: “The supreme destructive art of Milim Nava. Blinding stardust particles converge into a cataclysmic beam that obliterates anything caught in its celestial trajectory.”

0100.name: HELL FLARE CONTROL
0100.subtitle: Support Card

tournamentAbilities.name: Commander's Strategy
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. You may discard a card with a Recruitment keyword to draw 2 cards.

battleAbilities.name: Suppressive Fire
battleAbilities.description: For the next 3 combat rounds, when the bearer attacks, the opposing character gets -2 EV for that attack. This effect persists even if the bearer is defeated.

0100.flavorText: “Compressing ultra-high temperature flames within an inescapable dome. Benimaru's tactical precision traps opposing forces inside a miniature sun.”

0101.name: WEB OF STEEL THREADS
0101.subtitle: Support Card
0101.fullName: Web Of Steel Threads, Support Card

tournamentAbilities.name: Perfect Trap
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Attack: Choose an opponent. On their next turn, they must reveal all cards drawn; any drawn card costing more than 4 Energy must be shuffled back into their deck.

battleAbilities.name: Binding Field
battleAbilities.description: Play this card in your Field Area. While active, opponents must pay 500 HP from their current Active Character to switch Active Characters. If your Active Character is Souei, this cost increases to 1000 HP.

0101.flavorText: “Invisible threads of demonic steel crisscross the entire battlefield. A single step into this lethal spider's web seals an agonizing defeat.”

0102.name: SORA
0102.subtitle: The Manipulator

tournamentAbilities.name: Coin Toss
tournamentAbilities.description: Coin Toss - Generate 1 Energy. Gamble (Flip a Coin): (Win) Generate 1 additional Energy. (Lose) You cannot play any more Character cards this turn.

battleAbilities.name: Bluff
battleAbilities.description: Bluff - (Passive) If this character has less current HP than the opponent, it gains +2 EV.

0102.flavorText: “In this world, people don't lose to fate or luck; they lose to their own arrogance. And I am a master at making opponents believe they are invincible.”

0103.name: SORA
0103.subtitle: Humanity's Representative

tournamentAbilities.name: Negotiation
tournamentAbilities.description: Negotiation - Generate 1 Energy. Gamble: Choose an opponent. They choose odd or even, then roll a d6. (Win) You draw 1 card. (Lose) That opponent draws 1 card.

battleAbilities.name: Psychological Warfare
battleAbilities.description: Psychological Warfare - (Active) Gamble (Call Heads or Tails): (Win) The opponent gets -500 ATK this turn. (Lose) This character gets -200 ATK this turn.

0103.flavorText: “We are Imanity, the weakest of the sixteen races! Born with nothing, we hold the limitless potential to become anything!”

0104.name: SORA
0104.subtitle: King of Imanity

tournamentAbilities.name: All or Nothing
tournamentAbilities.description: All or Nothing - Generate 1 Energy. Gamble (Rock-Paper-Scissors with opponent): (Win) Generate 3 additional Energy. (Lose or Tie) Lose all Energy generated this round.

battleAbilities.name: Rule Bending
battleAbilities.description: Rule Bending - (Passive) While this character is active, you may reroll one Gamble attempt per turn (you must accept the second result).

0104.flavorText: “Never look down on humanity! A true king doesn't rule by force; he shows his people how to triumph using their minds.”

0105.name: SORA
0105.subtitle: The Grandmaster

tournamentAbilities.name: Checkmate Setup
tournamentAbilities.description: Checkmate Setup - Generate 2 Energy. Gamble (Guess High/Low on d20): (Win) Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may put 1 of them into your hand. (Lose) Draw 3 fewer cards during your next Draw Phase.

battleAbilities.name: Solution Calculation
battleAbilities.description: Solution Calculation - (Active) Gamble (Name a number 1-20, roll d20): (Win - Result is within 3 numbers of declaration) This attack deals double damage. (Lose) This attack deals half damage.

0105.flavorText: “Checkmate wasn't decided on this turn. The very second you agreed to sit across from me, the game was already over.”

0106.subtitle: God of Games

tournamentAbilities.name: Aschente
tournamentAbilities.description: Aschente - Generate 3 Energy. Cheat: Choose any non-Boss card in the Market. Its cost becomes 0 for you this turn (it still counts as buying a high-cost card if applicable). Only once per game.

battleAbilities.name: All According to Plan
battleAbilities.description: All According to Plan - (Enter) Reveal and maintain your opponent's entire Lineup revealed, then swap this card with a random card on your Lineup (roll 1dX, where X is the number of alive characters on your Lineup). (Reserve) At the start of any turn (yours or the opponent's), you may rearrange the order of the characters in your Reserve.

0106.flavorText: “『 』 never loses. Across every world and every dimension, there is no game that can withstand our united intellect.”

0107.name: SHIRO
0107.subtitle: Quiet Genius

tournamentAbilities.name: Analysis
tournamentAbilities.description: Analysis - Generate 0 Energy. Look at the top card of the Market deck.

battleAbilities.name: Calculation
battleAbilities.description: Calculation - (Passive) This character never misses attacks (ignores Evasion), but cannot score Critical Hits.

0107.flavorText: “Chess is merely a finite system of 10 to the 120th power states. To humanity, that feels like infinity; to me, it's just a simple equation.”

0108.name: SHIRO
0108.subtitle: Logical Gamer

tournamentAbilities.name: Predictive Algorithm
tournamentAbilities.description: Predictive Algorithm - Generate 1 Energy. Gamble (Roll d6): (Win - Even) Look at the top 3 cards of the Market Deck, arrange them in any order. (Lose - Odd) Shuffle the Market Deck.

battleAbilities.name: Dodge Calculation
battleAbilities.description: Dodge Calculation - (Active) Gamble (Roll d6): (Win - Even) Gain +4 EV for the next attack. (Lose - Odd) Lose -2 EV for the next attack.

0108.flavorText: “Wind speed zero. Ricochet angle calculated at 37.4 degrees. Target eliminated in 0.8 seconds.”

0109.name: SHIRO
0109.subtitle: Queen of Imanity

tournamentAbilities.name: Perfect Solution
tournamentAbilities.description: Perfect Solution - Generate 1 Energy. Gamble (Guess High/Low on d20): (Win) Draw 2 cards. (Lose) Skip your next Buy Phase turn.

battleAbilities.name: FPS Mode
battleAbilities.description: FPS Mode - (Passive) This character deals +500 damage if the opponent has higher current HP than you.

0109.flavorText: “Sora is my voice and heart, but I am the unbreakable foundation of our throne. Challenge our kingdom, and the math will be merciless.”

0110.name: SHIRO
0110.subtitle: Omega Computing

tournamentAbilities.name: Complete Knowledge
tournamentAbilities.description: Complete Knowledge - Permanent: Generate 1 Energy. At the start of each round, you may reveal an opponent's hand until the end of the round.

battleAbilities.name: Determinism
battleAbilities.description: Determinism - (Passive) Once per battle, you may change the result of any one die roll (yours or your opponent's) to a result of your choice.

0110.flavorText: “Every single outcome simulated across ten million possibilities. Probability of our defeat: 0.000000%.”

0111.name: JIBRIL
0111.subtitle: The Young Flügel

tournamentAbilities.name: Thirst for Knowledge
tournamentAbilities.description: Thirst for Knowledge - Generate 1 Energy.

battleAbilities.name: Aerial Strike
battleAbilities.description: Aerial Strike - (Passive) This character deals +400 damage to characters with less than 4 EV.

0111.flavorText: “A creature that does not hunger for knowledge is no better than dust. To an immortal Flügel, a single unread book is worth more than an empire.”

0112.name: JIBRIL
0112.subtitle: Library Master

tournamentAbilities.name: Forbidden Text
tournamentAbilities.description: Forbidden Text - Generate 1 Energy. Gamble (Roll d6): (Win - 5,6) Search: A Tactic or Equipment card. (Lose - 1,2,3,4) You cannot buy Tactic or Equipment cards this turn. This effect can only be used if you are able to resolve both its Win and Lose outcomes.

battleAbilities.name: Magic Barrier
battleAbilities.description: Magic Barrier - (Passive) Reduce damage received from Active abilities by 50%.

0112.flavorText: “Every ancient scroll and grimoire in this library was won with my own hands. Step inside, and you wager your entire existence.”

0113.name: JIBRIL
0113.subtitle: God Killer

tournamentAbilities.name: Ancient War
tournamentAbilities.description: Ancient War - Generate 2 Energy. Gamble (Roll d6): (Win - 6) Destroy a card in the Market. (Lose - 1) Destroy a card in your hand.

battleAbilities.name: Divine Smite
battleAbilities.description: Divine Smite - (Active) Once per battle Gamble (Coin Flip): (Win - Heads) Deal 1000 damage. (Lose - Tails) Take 500 damage, may use again this battle.

0113.flavorText: “Before these peaceful pledges existed, these wings bathed in the blood of Old Deus. Do not mistake my current politeness for weakness.”

0114.name: JIBRIL
0114.subtitle: Winged Catastrophe

tournamentAbilities.name: Shiritori
tournamentAbilities.description: Shiritori - Attack: Generate 2 Energy. Name a card type: Opponent reveals cards with that type in their hand and discards 1 random card of that type, if any. Gamble (For each player, name a card type and look at the top card of their deck): For each correct guess, draw 1 card. For each wrong guess, your opponent draws that card.

battleAbilities.name: Heaven's Strike
battleAbilities.description: Heaven's Strike - (Active) Once per battle, your next attack deals additional damage equal to 50% of the opponent's Max HP. This character cannot attack next turn.

0114.flavorText: “Heaven’s Strike! Let the sky shatter and the earth burn to glass before the ultimate wrath of the Sixth Race!”

0115.name: CHLAMMY
0115.subtitle: The Believer

tournamentAbilities.name: Hidden Card
tournamentAbilities.description: Hidden Card - Generate 1 Energy. Gamble (Guess the top card type of your deck): (Win) Add it to your hand. (Lose) Put it on the bottom of your deck.

battleAbilities.name: Distraction
battleAbilities.description: Distraction - (Passive) Opponent has -1 EV.

0115.flavorText: “Blind hope without power is mere foolishness. I swallowed my pride and walked through the dark because survival demands sacrifice.”

0116.name: CHLAMMY
0116.subtitle: Elf Partner

tournamentAbilities.name: Rigged Game
tournamentAbilities.description: Rigged Game - Generate 1 Energy. Look at an opponent's hand and Search: a card in your deck with the same name as a card in their hand.

battleAbilities.name: Illusion Magic
battleAbilities.description: Illusion Magic - (Active) Gamble (Coin Flip): (Win - Heads) Swap your current HP with your current ATK until the end of your next turn. (Lose - Tails) Your ATK becomes 0 until the end of your turn.

0116.flavorText: “The world sees a master and an enslaved human. But between Fii and me, there is only an unbreakable pledge of shared destiny.”

0117.name: CHLAMMY
0117.subtitle: Manipulator

tournamentAbilities.name: Forced Bet
tournamentAbilities.description: Forced Bet - Generate 1 Energy. Gamble (Roll d20 vs Opponent): (Win) Steal 1 Energy from the opponent (they lose 1 on their next turn). (Lose) Give 1 Energy to the opponent (they gain 1 on their next turn).

battleAbilities.name: False Information
battleAbilities.description: False Information - (Passive) (Reserve) While in Reserve, if the opponent uses an (Active) ability, they must flip a coin. If Tails, the ability fails.

0117.flavorText: “When an opponent assumes they are playing chess, you have already won by rewriting the board inside their mind.”

0118.name: CHLAMMY & FIEL
0118.subtitle: United Race

tournamentAbilities.name: Double Agent
tournamentAbilities.description: Double Agent - Generate 2 Energy. Draw 1 card for every Pact or Spirit card in your discard pile (maximum 4 cards).

battleAbilities.name: Memory Alteration
battleAbilities.description: Memory Alteration - (Active) Twice per game, disable an opponent's ability for the rest of the game.

0118.flavorText: “Two souls unbound by racial prejudice. Combining human cunning with ancient Elven sorcery, no kingdom can tear us apart.”

0119.name: IZUNA
0119.subtitle: Cute Werebeast

tournamentAbilities.name: Play with me!
tournamentAbilities.description: Play with me! - Generate 1 Energy.

battleAbilities.name: Wild Senses
battleAbilities.description: Wild Senses - (Passive) This character gains +100 ATK against Magic (Pact/Light/Dark) characters.

0119.flavorText: “You really thought you could sneak past my fox ears and tail, desu? I already heard your heartbeat before you even took a step!”

0120.name: IZUNA
0120.subtitle: Serious Gamer

tournamentAbilities.name: Instinctive Move
tournamentAbilities.description: Instinctive Move - Attack: Generate 1 Energy. Reveal the top card of an opponent's deck; discard it or leave it on top. Gamble (before Attack; guess the card's cost): (Win) Generate +1 Energy. (Lose) Lose 1 Energy.

battleAbilities.name: Reflexes
battleAbilities.description: Reflexes - (Active) Twice per battle, this character gains +2 EV for one turn.

0120.flavorText: “Gaming isn't just fooling around, desu! The moment I grip the controller, I play to dominate every single match!”

0121.name: IZUNA
0121.subtitle: Eastern Union Champion

tournamentAbilities.name: Limit Break
tournamentAbilities.description: Limit Break - Generate 1 Energy. Gamble (4/5/6 on a d6): (Win) Generate 2 Energy. (Lose) Lose 1 Energy.

battleAbilities.name: Sixth Sense
battleAbilities.description: Sixth Sense - (Passive) If this character successfully dodges an attack, it counters for 900 damage.

0121.flavorText: “The pride and future of all Werebeasts rest on my shoulders, desu. I will never surrender our homeland to anyone!”

0122.name: IZUNA HATSUSE
0122.subtitle: Blood Destruction

tournamentAbilities.name: Overload
tournamentAbilities.description: Overload - Generate 3 Energy. You cannot buy Support cards this turn and can only buy 1 card from the Market.

battleAbilities.name: Kekkai
battleAbilities.description: Kekkai - (Active) Once per battle, attack twice. Gamble (Once per battle, Roll d6): (Win - 6: You can use Active again this battle after this gamble) (Lose - 1 to 5: Lose 2000 HP).

0122.flavorText: “Blood Destruction! Surpassing the biological limits of physical reality... In this state, not even sound can outrun my claws, desu!”

0123.name: ASCHENTE
0123.subtitle: Support Card

tournamentAbilities.name: The Pledges
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy.

battleAbilities.name: Official Challenge
battleAbilities.description: Gamble: Both players roll a d20. The player with the higher roll wins. If you win, the opponent takes 1000 damage; if you lose, you take 1000 damage; on a tie, both take 1000 damage. Discard this card after use.

0123.flavorText: “‘Aschente!’ With raised right hands and sworn oaths, all violence is stripped away. On Disboard, destiny is decided solely through games.”

0124.name: STEPHANIE'S SUPPORT
0124.subtitle: Support Card

tournamentAbilities.name: Bad Luck?
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Gamble (coin flip): (Win) Draw 1 card. (Lose) Discard 1 card.

battleAbilities.name: Clumsy Dodge
battleAbilities.description: Until the end of the next round, negate the first elemental advantage damage against you each round. If slotted with a No Game No Life character, also negate the first Lose effect of a Gamble.

0124.flavorText: “Call me a fool if you must, but I will defend my grandfather's legacy and support our sovereigns with every fiber of my being!”

0125.name: ELF ASSISTANT
0125.subtitle: Support Card

tournamentAbilities.name: Magical Buff
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 2 Energy.

battleAbilities.name: Elfic Magic
battleAbilities.description: For the next 3 combat rounds, if your Gamble would result in a Lose, you may reroll once; you must accept the second result. If slotted with Chlammy, she also gains +2 EV for the duration.

0125.flavorText: “An open grimoire of ancient Elven arcana. When invisible hexes weave through the air, victory is secured before the dice are cast.”

0126.name: SHIRO'S SMARTPHONE
0126.subtitle: Support Card

tournamentAbilities.name: Otherworldly Tech
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 2 Energy. Look at the top 2 cards of your deck and return them in any order.

battleAbilities.name: Digital Calculation
battleAbilities.description: (Attach) Attach to a character. The attached character gains this card's stats. (Passive) The attached character ignores the opponent's Passive abilities during your turn.

0126.flavorText: “A relic from another world. On this glowing screen, four characters conquered every high score: 『 』.”

0127.name: TOHSAKA TOKIOMI & GILGAMESH
0127.subtitle: Noble Heirs

tournamentAbilities.name: Elegant Treasury
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. If you have a Permanent card in play, generate +1 Energy.

battleAbilities.name: Gate of Babylon
battleAbilities.description: Twice per battle Deal 200 damage to opponent's Active Character. This damage is neutral (no elemental modifiers).

0127.flavorText: “A lineage steeped in elegance and absolute pride. Tokiomi bows with exquisite decorum, masking the tension of serving history's most arrogant king.”

0128.name: TOHSAKA TOKIOMI & GILGAMESH
0128.subtitle: Key Keepers

tournamentAbilities.name: Mage's Providence
tournamentAbilities.description: Destroy 1 card from your hand or discard pile. Search: A Bronze or Silver card. That card costs 1 less to you this round.

battleAbilities.name: Sha Nagba Imuru
battleAbilities.description: Ignore all Evasion bonuses on target when attacking.

0128.flavorText: “Holding the catalyst to the world's oldest treasury. With supreme aristocratic grace, Tokiomi orchestrates the fourth Holy Grail War from his study.”

0129.name: TOHSAKA TOKIOMI & GILGAMESH
0129.subtitle: The Golden Covenant
0129.fullName: Tohsaka Tokiomi & Gilgamesh, The Golden Covenant

tournamentAbilities.name: King's Order
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 2 Energy. You may put a card from hand to bottom of deck; if you do, draw 2.

battleAbilities.name: Enuma Elish
battleAbilities.description: Once per battle, pay 1500 HP. Deal 1200 damage to Active Character.

0129.flavorText: “‘Rejoice, Tokiomi. For my gaze alone elevates your humble lineage into legend.’ Crimson portals part, revealing Babylon's boundless armory.”

0130.name: TOHSAKA TOKIOMI & GILGAMESH
0130.subtitle: Arbiters of Victory
0130.fullName: Tohsaka Tokiomi & Gilgamesh, Arbiters of Victory

tournamentAbilities.name: Treasury of Babylon
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 2 Energy. Attack: Choose any non-Boss card from any discard pile; create a temporary copy in your hand (discard it at the end of the turn).

battleAbilities.name: Vimana Control
battleAbilities.description: Once per battle, reorder your Reserve Lineup. You may swap this card with a card in your Reserve Line. (Reserve) Command Seal: Pay 1000 HP from your Active Character to swap it with another card in your Reserve Line.

0130.flavorText: “A master of flame sorcery backed by the unmatched majesty of the King of Heroes. When Gilgamesh opens the Gate of Babylon, no mortal can stand.”

0131.name: TOHSAKA TOKIOMI & GILGAMESH
0131.subtitle: King of Heroes
0131.fullName: Tohsaka Tokiomi & Gilgamesh, King of Heroes

tournamentAbilities.name: Genesis of All Things
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 3 Energy. Reveal the top card of your deck. If it is Silver, Gold, Diamond, or Boss, add it to your hand.

battleAbilities.name: Ea: Sword of Rupture
battleAbilities.description: Once per game, charge for 2 rounds (no attack or Active abilities). Then deal 2000 damage to all enemy characters (Active + Reserve Line). If you receive Stun, Sleep, Confuse, or Disarm, cancel the charge. Command Seal: Pay 1000 HP to become immune to Stun, Sleep, Confuse, and Disarm while charging.

0131.flavorText: “‘Who gave you permission to look upon me, mongrel?’ Turning the sky gold with uncounted Noble Phantasms, the ancient sovereign claims all creation as his garden.”

0132.name: EMIYA KIRITSUGU & ARTHORIA
0132.subtitle: Unlikely Pair

tournamentAbilities.name: Practical Tactics
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Look at top deck; may put on bottom.

battleAbilities.name: Invisible Air
battleAbilities.description: Once per battle Deal 400 damage. Target loses 400 ATK until your next round start.

0132.flavorText: “An assassin who scorns glory paired with a legendary monarch sworn to chivalry. Two broken souls chasing the same miracle down irreconcilable paths.”

0133.name: EMIYA KIRITSUGU & ARTHORIA
0133.subtitle: Sword and Gun
0133.fullName: Emiya Kiritsugu & Arthoria, Sword and Gun

tournamentAbilities.name: Time Alter
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Attack: Discard 1 card; target opponent discards 1 random card.

battleAbilities.name: Mana Burst
battleAbilities.description: If your next attack hits, also deal 700 direct damage (ignores EV).

0133.flavorText: “While the King of Knights cuts through darkness with Invisible Air, the Magus Killer measures wind drift and bullet trajectories through night-vision scopes.”

0134.name: EMIYA KIRITSUGU & ARTHORIA
0134.subtitle: Ideals Collide

tournamentAbilities.name: Origin Bullet

[Ken]: Defend: Negate an opponent's Attack keyword targeting you; discard this card from your hand to generate 1 Energy. [Shu]: Target 1 card in your hand; it gains Retain (1) this turn.

battleAbilities.name: Jajanken: Gu
battleAbilities.description: Once per game: [Gu ✊] - This character's next attack gains +1000 ATK, but the target character gains +2 EV against it. Nen 6: Recharge this character's (Active) skill.

0179_po.name: GON
0179_po.subtitle: Unleashed Potential (Po)

tournamentAbilities.name: Advanced Nen
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. When you play this card, choose one stance for the round: [Ko], [Ken], or [Shu]. [Ko]: Attack: All opponents discard 2 cards at random; you cannot use Defend abilities until the start of your next turn. [Ken]: Defend: Negate an opponent's Attack keyword targeting you; discard this card from your hand to generate 1 Energy. [Shu]: Target 1 card in your hand; it gains Retain (1) this turn.

battleAbilities.name: Jajanken: Po
battleAbilities.description: Once per game: [Po ✋] - This character's next attack can target any character in the opponent's Reserve line. Nen 6: Recharge this character's (Active) skill.

0179_po.flavorText: “Emitting nen into an explosive ranged blast... Jajanken: Po!”

0179_chi.name: GON
0179_chi.subtitle: Unleashed Potential (Chi)

tournamentAbilities.name: Advanced Nen
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. When you play this card, choose one stance for the round: [Ko], [Ken], or [Shu]. [Ko]: Attack: All opponents discard 2 cards at random; you cannot use Defend abilities until the start of your next turn. [Ken]: Defend: Negate an opponent's Attack keyword targeting you; discard this card from your hand to generate 1 Energy. [Shu]: Target 1 card in your hand; it gains Retain (1) this turn.

battleAbilities.name: Jajanken: Chi
battleAbilities.description: Once per game: [Chi ✌️] - This character's next attack completely ignores 2 EV of the target character. Nen 6: Recharge this character's (Active) skill.

0179_chi.flavorText: “Transmuting aura into a razor-sharp blade... Jajanken: Chi!”

0180.name: GON FREECSS
0180.subtitle: Silent Wrath

tournamentAbilities.name: Show Me Kaito
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 2 Energy. Attack: Target opponent must reveal their hand. If they do not reveal a card with a Defend/Defense, they must discard their entire hand. This ability cannot be Defend or React effects.

battleAbilities.name: Vow My Life
battleAbilities.description: Once per game, gain +1000 Max HP and +1000 ATK, but lose -4 EV (heal this character for 1000 HP when Max HP increases). At the end of this battle, destroy this character wherever it is located and remove it from the game entirely (it cannot be revived).

0180.flavorText: “All cheerful warmth drained away, replaced by an abyss of bottomless rage. Facing Pitou, the boy chooses to throw away everything.”

0181.name: GON FREECSS
0181.subtitle: The End of Hope
0181.fullName: Gon Freecss, The End of Hope

tournamentAbilities.name: I... will kill you...
tournamentAbilities.description: Attack (Max 3 times per turn): Target opponent discards a card at random. Each time an opponent discards a card due to this effect, choose one: Generate 1 Energy; or Destroy 1 card from your hand or discard pile.

battleAbilities.name: The End of Hope
battleAbilities.description: At the start of your turn, this character loses 2000 HP. (Enter) Once per game, this character gains +2000 Max HP for each of your characters already defeated in this battle (heal for the same amount). Nen 8: Trigger this character's (Enter) effect an additional time.

0181.flavorText: “‘I don’t care if this is the end... so I’ll use everything.’ An adult body born of ultimate despair, shattering gods with blows of apocalyptic consequence.”

0182.name: KILLUA
0182.subtitle: Heir of Assassins

tournamentAbilities.name: Killer Instinct
tournamentAbilities.description: For each successful attack that hit an opponent during the previous tournament round, generate 1 Energy (Max 2 Energy per turn).

battleAbilities.name: Killer Stab
battleAbilities.description: Deal 400 damage to the opponent's Active Character (this damage can trigger element advantages).

0182.flavorText: “Trained from birth in torture, poison, and execution. Beneath his mischievous grin lies an assassin capable of plucking out a heart in a blink.”

0183.name: KILLUA
0183.subtitle: Loyal Companion

tournamentAbilities.name: Skateboard
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. If you landed a successful attack that hit an opponent during the previous tournament round, draw 1 card.

battleAbilities.name: Razor Nails
battleAbilities.description: Successful attacks that hit an opponent apply Bleeding (2 Turns).

0183.flavorText: “Walking beside Gon, Killua learns the meaning of a true friend. For the first time, he fights not because he was ordered to, but because he wants to protect.”

0184.name: KILLUA
0184.subtitle: High Voltz

tournamentAbilities.name: Izutsuchi
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. React: Reveal this card from your hand when an opponent draws a card due to a card effect; negate that draw, and that opponent cannot draw cards through card effects for the rest of this turn (Once per round).

battleAbilities.name: Narukami
battleAbilities.description: Once per battle, deal 700 damage. If this attack has an elemental advantage against the target, double the damage and apply Stun (1 Turn). Nen 4: Recharge this character's (Active) skill.

0184.flavorText: “Transmuting his aura into high-voltage electricity! Electric currents course through his veins, numbing enemies with every paralyzing touch.”

0185.name: KILLUA ZOLDYCK
0185.subtitle: Godspeed Mode

tournamentAbilities.name: Godspeed: Shippu Jinrai
tournamentAbilities.description: Permanent: Generate 1 Energy. Negate the first Attack keyword used against you each turn; the player who used it must discard 1 card from their hand.

battleAbilities.name: Godspeed: Denko Sekka
battleAbilities.description: You may attack twice this turn. (Active) Twice per game, swap this character's position with a character in your Reserve line. Nen 5: Gain 1 additional activation of this character's (Active) skill.

0185.flavorText: “Godspeed: Shippu Jinrai! Transmitting nerve signals as pure lightning, his reflexes bypass conscious thought to achieve impossible velocity.”

0186.name: KURAPIKA
0186.subtitle: Last of the Kurta

tournamentAbilities.name: Kurta Survivor
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Defend: Discard this card from your hand to draw 1 card.

battleAbilities.name: Avenger’s Will
battleAbilities.description: Your attacks deal +300 additional damage if the target has defeated a character from your Lineup during this battle. This damage ignores all shields, damage reduction, and elemental interactions.

0186.flavorText: “The sole survivor of a slaughtered clan. Behind his composed demeanor lies an eternity of grief burning for retribution against the Phantom Troupe.”

0187.name: KURAPIKA
0187.subtitle: Blacklist Hunter

tournamentAbilities.name: Bounty Hunt
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Attack: Target opponent reveals 1 random card from their hand; Search: 1 card from the Market Deck that shares a first name with the revealed card.

battleAbilities.name: Spider Slayer
battleAbilities.description: This character's attacks ignore 2 EV of Dark element characters.

0187.flavorText: “Donning the suit of a bodyguard in the criminal underworld of Yorknew. Five chains dangle from his fingers, each bound to a lethal purpose.”

0188.name: KURAPIKA
0188.subtitle: Avenger's Resolve

tournamentAbilities.name: Dousing Chain
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Search: A random card belonging to any specific Universe.

battleAbilities.name: Chain Jail
battleAbilities.description: Once per game, apply [Bind] to the opponent's Active Character. (Passive) Characters with Bind cannot declare attacks; the controlling player must roll an 11 or higher on a d20 at the start of their turn to remove the Bind status. Nen 6: Trigger this character's (Enter) effect an additional time.

0188.flavorText: “‘A condition etched into my heart, with death as the price of violation.’ Chain Jail tightens around the Spiders, forcing them into absolute Zetsu.”

0189.name: KURAPIKA
0189.subtitle: Emperor Time

tournamentAbilities.name: All Nen Types
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 2 Energy. Search: A card belonging to any chosen Element.

battleAbilities.name: Specialization Nen: Emperor Time
battleAbilities.description: Once per battle, change one of this character's Elements to any other Element for the remainder of this battle. Nen 4: Recharge this character's (Active) skill.

0189.flavorText: “When his eyes glow crimson scarlet, Emperor Time awakens—granting 100% mastery over every nen category at the cost of his own lifespan.”

0190.name: LEORIO
0190.subtitle: Aspiring Doctor

tournamentAbilities.name: Money for Medicine
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. You may pay 1 Energy to shuffle 1 card from your discard pile into your deck.

battleAbilities.name: First Aid
battleAbilities.description: Once per battle, reveal this card from your Reserve line to heal your Active Character for 800 HP. Nen 3: Hide this character.

0190.flavorText: “Loud, stubborn, and dressed in a cheap business suit. He claims he only wants money, but his true dream is to heal the poor without charging a single cent.”

0191.name: LEORIO
0191.subtitle: Reliable Ally

tournamentAbilities.name: Empathic Doctor
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Defend: Shuffle 1 card from your discard pile into your deck, then discard this card from your hand.

battleAbilities.name: Charisma
battleAbilities.description: When this character is targeted by an attack, you may roll a d20. On a result of 12 or higher, swap this character's position with the next character in your Reserve line. Nen 6: Remove this character from your lineup. Choose a card on your Lineup, that card gain [Charisma] until end of duel.

0191.flavorText: “He may not have godlike combat skills, but his heart is bigger than the entire exam. When friends fall, Leorio is the first to step into harm's way.”

0192.name: LEORIO
0192.subtitle: Righteous Fist

tournamentAbilities.name: Rescue
tournamentAbilities.description: Shuffle all cards you discarded this turn back into your deck, then draw 1 card. Defend: Discard this card from your hand to generate 1 temporary Energy that lasts until the end of your turn, shuffle your discard onto your deck and draw a card.

battleAbilities.name: Combat Doctor
battleAbilities.description: Once per game, when your Active Character is defeated, you may revive it and restore its HP to 1000. Nen 10: Recharge this character's (Reserve) skill.

0192.flavorText: “Warping punch through space itself! Infused with righteous indignation, his emission strike sends chairman candidates flying across the stage.”

0193.name: LEORIO PARADINIGHT
0193.subtitle: Medical Savior

tournamentAbilities.name: Medical Expert
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 2 Energy. Target 1 card in either your discard pile or the Market discard pile. If targeted in your discard pile: Add it to your hand. If targeted in the Market discard pile: You may recruit it this turn as if it were in the Market Row for 1 less Energy.

battleAbilities.name: Tele-punch
battleAbilities.description: Once per battle, you may target any character in the opponent's Lineup (Active or Reserve); deal damage equal to this character's ATK to the target. This attack cannot be dodged and ignores all active Shield or damage reduction effects.

0193.flavorText: “A master doctor whose ultrasound nen can detect and sever ailments invisible to modern science. A healer whose hands save lives when all hope is lost.”

0194.name: HISOKA
0194.subtitle: Enigmatic Jester

tournamentAbilities.name: Playing Examiner
tournamentAbilities.description: Permanent: Generate 0 Energy. Each time you are targeted by an opponent's Attack keyword, generate 1 temporary Energy that lasts until the end of your turn; discard this card at the end of the turn.

battleAbilities.name: Menacing Aura
battleAbilities.description: The opponent's Active Character loses -3 EV for the remainder of this combat round. Nen 4: You may reveal this card from your reserve line and activate [Menacing Aura] as if this card was active.

0194.flavorText: “A mercurial wanderer who seeks thrill in life-or-death battles. To Hisoka, allies and enemies are merely fruits waiting to ripen before the harvest.”

0195.name: HISOKA
0195.subtitle: Cruel Magician

tournamentAbilities.name: Surprise Texture
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. You may reveal this card from your hand at any time to declare that it gains any game Keyword; this declared Keyword has no functional effect.

battleAbilities.name: Properties of Gum
battleAbilities.description: The opponent's Active Character cannot be swapped or moved, and it loses -1 EV for the remainder of this battle. Nen 3: Trigger this character's (Enter) effect an additional time.

0195.flavorText: “Shuffling a deck of razor-sharp playing cards with casual cruelty. One careless blink, and a painted card will slit your throat with surgical precision.”

0196.name: HISOKA
0196.subtitle: Spider No. 4

tournamentAbilities.name: Pulling the Strings
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Attack: Reveal the top card of each opponent's deck, you may add then to your hand; place those cards back onto the top of their respective decks at the end of your turn.

battleAbilities.name: Properties of Rubber
battleAbilities.description: Whenever an opponent's attack fails its Evasion check, this character may immediately make an out-of-turn attack against them. Nen 8: Move this character to the bottom of your Reserve line; this character's (Passive) skill functions from the Reserve line for the remainder of this battle.

0196.flavorText: “Infiltrating the Phantom Troupe for a single selfish desire: to duel Chrollo Lucilfer. His fake spider tattoo masks a hunter who obeys only his own whim.”

0197.name: HISOKA MOROW
0197.subtitle: Grim Reaper

tournamentAbilities.name: Grow Until It's Time
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 2 Energy. Destroy: You may destroy the next non-basic card you play this turn. After 2 rounds, Search: Look through the Market Deck for a card with the same name as the destroyed card but one higher rarity, and add it to your discard pile (you cannot search for Boss rarity cards with this effect).

battleAbilities.name: Bungee Gum
battleAbilities.description: Once per battle: If this character's next attack hits, place a Bungee Gum counter on the target. Characters with a Bungee Gum counter cannot be swapped or moved, and they lose -1 EV. (Passive) When a target accumulates 3 Bungee Gum counters, your next attack against them automatically hits and consumes all counters. Nen 1: Recharge this character's (Active) skill.

0197.flavorText: “‘Bungee Gum possesses the properties of both rubber and gum.’ Whispering gently as invisible elastic threads drag opponents into unavoidable doom.”

0198.name: GODSPEED TRANSMUTATION
0198.subtitle: Support Card

tournamentAbilities.name: Electric Aura
tournamentAbilities.description: (Permanent) The first two times each turn that an opponent draws cards through a card effect, they must discard a card first.

battleAbilities.name: Blitz Hit
battleAbilities.description: Your next attack applies Stun if it hits. If used by Killua, also reduce the opponent's EV by 2 for the next attack.

0198.flavorText: “Circulating electric aura directly into the nervous system. Instantaneous synaptic acceleration outpaces the very speed of human reaction.”

0199.name: JUDGMENT CHAIN
0199.subtitle: Support Card

tournamentAbilities.name: Avenger's Investigation
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Search: Target 1 card in any player's discard pile; look through the Market Deck for a card that shares an Element with the targeted card.

battleAbilities.name: Do a Vow
battleAbilities.description: (Attach) Attach to a character. The attached character gains this card's stats. Name a character as your Vow target. (Active) Once per battle, when facing a character whose name matches the Vow, your next attack automatically hits and is treated as effective regardless of your Element. If the bearer is Kurapika, you may spend 2 Nen to recharge this skill.

0199.flavorText: “A dagger of nen wrapped around the target’s heart. Obey the terms of the vow, or the blade pierces your life in an instant.”

0200.name: MEDICAL BAG
0200.subtitle: Support Card

tournamentAbilities.name: Emergency Supplies
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. You may target 1 card in your discard pile and place it on the bottom of your deck.

battleAbilities.name: Doctor's Toolkit
battleAbilities.description: (Attach) Attach to a character. The attached character gains this card's stats. (Passive) Whenever the attached character receives healing, increase the HP restored by 300. If the bearer is Leorio, you may spend 3 Nen at the start of your turn to remove all negative status effects from your lineup.

0200.flavorText: “Packed with scalpel kits, antidote vials, and first-aid supplies. In the heat of deadly combat, a quick suture can mean the difference between life and death.”

0201.name: JOKER DECK
0201.subtitle: Support Card

tournamentAbilities.name: Card Shuffle
tournamentAbilities.description: Generate 1 Energy. Attack: Look at an opponent's hand. You may choose 1 card from their hand and place it at the bottom of their deck. If you do, that opponent draws 1 card.

battleAbilities.name: Deadly Jester
battleAbilities.description: Slotted with any character. (Active) For the next 3 turns, once per combat round when the bearer declares an attack, you may flip a coin. Heads: The next attack deals +500 damage. Tails: The bearer gains +1 EV until the end of the round. If the bearer is Hisoka, you may also flip a coin when your opponent declares an attack.

0201.flavorText: “Coated in shu and razor-sharp aura, ordinary playing cards become lethal projectiles capable of slicing through concrete and armor alike.”
